psychological_meaning: Deep Sea evokes feelings of tranquility, mystery, and depth. It is often associated with the ocean's hidden depths, suggesting introspection, stability, and a sense of calm. This color can also represent wisdom, trust, and a connection to the natural world.

real_world_examples.title: Deep Sea Kelp Forest
real_world_examples.description: Underwater kelp forests present a vibrant example of this color in its natural habitat, showcasing its depth and association with marine life.

real_world_examples.title: Modern Architecture Accent
real_world_examples.description: Deep Sea can be used in architectural accents to give a building a modern, sophisticated look while evoking a sense of calm.

how_to_pair: Pair with neutrals for a sophisticated look.
Combine with complementary colors for contrast.
Use lighter shades for a softer, more airy feel.
